capabilities: Import Are.na channels and blocks as Markdown notes with pagination and retries
Preview imports with dry-run and per-file diff summaries
Download, embed, or link images and attachments with configurable storage
Generate channel index notes and a master overview note
Customize generated Markdown with a Handlebars-like template engine
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync engine; it only imports Are.na content into the vault and never pushes changes back.
extras: Points users to a published docs site for the full user guide, settings reference, and troubleshooting; mentions sister tool Make It Rain for Raindrop.io imports.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Are.na channels and blocks into the vault as stable Markdown notes with attachments.

relations.evidence: Banner frontmatter field for Banners plugin compatibility
Supports channel index naming mode for Folder Note compatibility

summary: One-way importer that brings Are.na channels, blocks, metadata, and attachments into the vault as deterministic Markdown notes.
